name: Detect background
description: Estimates the dominant page background from boundary-connected pixels and requires user confirmation before region detection.

fields.name: estimated_color
fields.description: Displays the automatically estimated RGB background color selected from the dominant boundary-connected color cluster.

fields.name: confirmed_color
fields.description: Stores the color approved by the user. It initially mirrors the estimate but may be replaced by a sampled or manually entered color.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Measures confidence in the automatic estimate from zero to one using cluster dominance, boundary connectivity, and color consistency.

fields.name: boundary_coverage
fields.description: Reports the fraction of sampled boundary pixels supporting the proposed background cluster.

fields.name: sample_radius_px
fields.description: Controls the radius of a manual image sample so compression noise and individual anomalous pixels do not determine the color.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.description: Indicates that the user has approved the background color. Region detection remains unavailable until this is true.

actions.name: Estimate background
actions.description: Samples boundary-connected pixels, clusters near-identical colors, rejects isolated foreground objects, and proposes the dominant background.

actions.name: Pick from image
actions.description: Samples a user-selected pixel neighborhood and assigns its robust average as the proposed confirmed color.

actions.name: Confirm background
actions.description: Commits the selected background color as a recoverable workflow state and enables region detection.

invalidation.name: background_change
invalidation.description: Changing a confirmed background invalidates all region masks, automatic fits, and derived diagnostics while retaining prior versions.
